author: Silver Cymbal
description:
Why is there always junk on the outside of your Windshield despite scrubbing & cleaning? Are you tired of streaks & haze? Baked on bird poop that defies removal?  Forget overpriced cleaners that let you down. I show you a cheap & easy easy to super clean the outside of your cars windshield like a PRO that you can do yourself with home made DIY window cleaner.  Previously, I shared my tips for cleaning the INSIDE of your car's windshield. Now let's get the outside down even better, your eyes will not believe how clean it can be.
